results.name: Christmas set Polar Holiday

results.name: Holly Blaze Christmas Cake
results.description:
**Backstory:** Born from a baker’s childhood memory of decorating gingerbread houses under twinkling lights, *Holly Blaze* blends nostalgia with bold holiday flair. Inspired by vintage candy tins and the warmth of family gatherings, this cake was crafted to be the centerpiece of any festive table.

**Item Description:**  
Celebrate the season with *Holly Blaze*, a handcrafted holiday cake wrapped in red fondant and adorned with white snowflakes, green sugar crystals, and a golden-baked top. Finished with candy cane stripes, holly leaves, and festive spheres, it’s a visual feast and a sweet indulgence. Moist vanilla sponge meets spiced caramel glaze inside. Perfect for gifting or entertaining. Serves 8–10. Store in a cool, dry place. Limited seasonal release.

results.name: Gingerheart Glow Christmas Cake
results.description:
**Backstory:** Inspired by the warmth of handmade holiday crafts and the charm of gingerbread traditions, *Gingerheart Glow* was created to evoke cozy evenings, twinkling lights, and heartfelt gatherings. Its cheerful centerpiece—a smiling gingerbread figure with a red heart—symbolizes love and togetherness.

**Item Description:**  
Celebrate the season with *Gingerheart Glow*, a festive cake wrapped in smooth vanilla icing and trimmed with fondant holly, red berries, and delicate snowflakes. A bright red ribbon and bow encircle the base, while a gingerbread character with a heart-shaped chest smiles atop. Inside: layers of spiced molasses cake and cinnamon cream filling. Serves 8–10. Keep refrigerated. Best enjoyed within 5 days. Limited holiday release.

results.name: Christmas tree 3
results.description: In the heart of a festive home, a majestic fir tree commands attention, its lush branches adorned with an exquisite array of ornaments. Every limb of the tree is meticulously adorned—glittering baubles suspended like captured stars, delicate glass ornaments reflecting the soft glow of fairy lights, and strands of tinsel elegantly draped, casting shimmering reflections around the room. The tree, a symphony of colors and textures, stands as a beacon of holiday cheer, its greenery a canvas for the artistry of decorations. Its presence transforms the space, infusing it with warmth and an unmistakable air of magic, inviting all to revel in the enchantment of the season.

results.name: The Lapworths' Christmas printing block
results.description:
A festive printing block used by Charles & Janet Lapworth to deliver their Christmas greetings in 1895.

The printing block consists of a wooden mount, onto which is pinned a relief-cut stone plate that bears the message: 
With the Season's Greetings
from 
Prof. & Mrs. C. Lapworth. 1895
Mason College Birmingham

The plate also contains palaeontological and geological images, which include a trilobite, an ammonite, graptolites, a map of the UK and a mountainous landscape.

Scanned by A. Jones using an Artec Spider structured light scanner.
